data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 Austria factsheet summarizes how 15-year-old students in Austria performed in mathematics, reading, and science, and how results changed relative to earlier PISA cycles (notably 2018 and 2012). It reports descriptive benchmarks such as mean score trends, proficiency-level shares (e.g., Level 2 baseline and Level 5/6 top performers), and subgroup patterns including socioeconomic divides (ESCS quintiles/quartiles), gender differences, and immigrant background gaps. The assessment uses two two-hour subject tests with rotated booklets (different students receive different item combinations) and includes student and school questionnaires. Austria is reported as meeting PISA technical quality standards for reporting, and the factsheet provides uncertainty via 95% confidence intervals. Because this is a results factsheet rather than an ML study, no predictive modeling, PV re-estimation procedure, or missing-data handling strategy is specified in the text.
